title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 SGA repair022 French diagram/prose source-indexed audit pass
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs, while adding the SGA5/SGA6 repair022 package as the latest SGA5 French source-indexed diagram/prose repair pass.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition or critical edition. Repair022 continues the SGA5 French repair lane around Exposé III, Théorème 4.4, closing source pp.102-107 / current French PDF pp.61-66 for this pass. It restores the large diagram (4.4.2), formula (4.4.6), and formula/prose around (4.4.7), and includes source-indexed 484-page audit companions, page maps, equation/diagram/structural-object/footnote ledgers, diffs, rendered witnesses, and source-scan witnesses. SGA6 French is carried forward unchanged in this pass. SGA5 English remains an unsynchronized carry-forward branch. SGA6 and SGA7 material should still be read with explicit working-draft/compression caveats unless a specific packet declares narrower source-checked coverage.

File-surface curation note. The SGA record is at Zenodo's 100-file ceiling. This version removes the superseded small repair020 public-summary JSON from the latest file surface in order to add sga5_sga6_repair022_20260612.zip. The removed summary and all previous attached packages remain preserved in earlier Zenodo versions.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, or Source-Checked are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
